hook.notes: hook.jpg: from 1.3 s the title JEDES KOMPLIMENT and the first note landing on du; by 3 s three handwritten notes and the second line – NICHT GESAGT?; clear premise in 3 s.

continuity.notes: cuts-001..006: du always teal hoodie; note count matches the story (1 after 18.6, 2 after 30.2, 3 after 35.6, then 2/1/0 after each peel on Tuesday); colleague glasses+bun, new colleague curly mustard, mother short hair red apron consistent across cuts.

pacing.notes: overview + cut sheets: 34 shots, alternating medium/close/insert/graphic; every shot has camera push or action within 4 s; no repeated identical composition back to back.
